description: Per-feature constraint registry. direction: -1 protective, +1 risk-increasing, 0 unconstrained. immutable: recourse may not move the feature. step_fraction: the largest fraction of the feature's observed range a single recourse plan may move it by, null where the feature is immutable.

LIMIT_BAL.justification: -1: bank-set credit limit reflects the applicant's assessed capacity; higher limit correlates with lower default probability at origination.

SEX.justification: 0: demographic proxy — deliberately unconstrained to avoid a fair-lending direction claim this dataset cannot substantiate.

EDUCATION.justification: 0: demographic proxy — same rationale as SEX.

MARRIAGE.justification: 0: demographic proxy — same rationale as SEX.

AGE.justification: 0: Yeh & Lien (2009) show middle-aged applicants have the highest default rate in this dataset; a monotone direction is not defensible.

PAY_0.justification: +1: repayment delay status for the most recent month; larger integer codes = more months delayed = strictly higher risk.

PAY_2.justification: +1: repayment delay status two months back; same direction as PAY_0.

PAY_3.justification: +1: repayment delay status three months back; same direction as PAY_0.

PAY_4.justification: +1: repayment delay status four months back; same direction as PAY_0.

PAY_5.justification: +1: repayment delay status five months back; same direction as PAY_0.

PAY_6.justification: +1: repayment delay status six months back; same direction as PAY_0.

BILL_AMT1.justification: 0: bill amount alone is directionally ambiguous without a utilisation ratio (higher bill can indicate more spending activity OR higher risk).

PAY_AMT1.justification: -1: actual payment amount for the most recent month; larger payment = better repayment behaviour = strictly lower risk.

PAY_AMT2.justification: -1: payment amount two months back; same direction as PAY_AMT1.

PAY_AMT3.justification: -1: payment amount three months back; same direction as PAY_AMT1.

PAY_AMT4.justification: -1: payment amount four months back; same direction as PAY_AMT1.

PAY_AMT5.justification: -1: payment amount five months back; same direction as PAY_AMT1.

PAY_AMT6.justification: -1: payment amount six months back; same direction as PAY_AMT1.
